title: National Bioenergy Mission
definition: A strategic policy framework under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) aimed at promoting the generation of energy from biomass, agricultural residues, and organic waste to achieve energy security and decarbonization.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Environment/Energy) and GS Paper II (Governance). It links directly to India's Net Zero 2070 target, circular economy, and farmers' income enhancement.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of National Bioenergy Mission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC)
